meta.description: Portfolio of Kaori, a software engineer.

description.aim: My aim is to deliver efficient tech products to the people who need them, so they can enjoy a great experience and their lives get a little better :)
description.focus: I focus on designing and architecting frontend code (AI-friendly code, UI component libraries, and design systems), and on building pleasant, effective teams.

cleanCode.heading: The Role of the Frontend
cleanCode.body: I see the frontend as the interface between users and data. With that in mind, I aim to write code that is easy to extend and performs well. I also keep the codebase clean and well-structured, so the code stays high quality even when coding agents do the implementation.

philosophy.heading: Philosophy
philosophy.body: Releases are always a little nerve-wracking for me. I keep working to take as much of the worry out of releasing as I can, and I want to strengthen our collaboration with automated testing and QA teams.

team.heading: Team Love
team.body: For me, one of the most important things at work is the team. I believe a good team builds a good product. So what makes a good team? It depends on the people in it. For me, it's a kind and respectful atmosphere, continuous learning and improvement, and a healthy work-life balance. I'd love to hear from you: what makes a good team for you?

extra.heading: Extra
extra.lead: I write a tech blog and work on a personal project.
extra.closing: In my free time, I relax at a lovely café with sweeeeets or play video games.
